app.backend_slow: backend is taking a while to connect — if this persists, reload
app.subtitle: Midnight Club 3 · soundtrack
home.intro: Project overview and the **step-by-step** workflow — from the original disc to the final ISO.
prep.intro: Extracts the Midnight Club 3 ISO into an **editable workspace** (**ASSETS/**, **STREAMS/**, **mcstrings02.json**) — the data every editing screen needs. It only reads the ISO and only writes to new folders.
prep.log_placeholder: — the preparation log shows up here —
prep.reimport_confirm: The workspace is already prepared — I understand that re-importing **deletes the current extraction**
prep.reset_confirm: I understand this **deletes the current extraction** from the workspace (backups are kept)
prep.reset_intro: Deletes the **current extraction** (the "Arquivos da ISO" folder, ASSETS, STREAMS, mcstrings) so you can start over with **another ISO**. **Backups are kept** and any ISO you already built is left untouched.
prep.tools_ok_not_ready: tools OK · workspace not prepared yet
add.batch_placeholder: — choose several files to edit each track —
add.confirm: I understand this **changes the workspace** (an automatic backup is made)
add.intro: Pick your **MP3/FLAC/WAV** directly — **conversion to RSM is automatic** when adding, so you **don't need to convert first**. It installs the track in the game (converts it, adds it to the **playlists** and **strings**, rebuilds the STRTBL) and makes an **automatic backup** before changing anything.
add.log_placeholder: — the add log shows up here —
add.no_playlists_yet: conversion tools ready · workspace has no playlists yet
add.pl_none_available: — no playlists (the workspace has no game files) —
add.presets_help: **Full default** = safe coverage (all of them). **Genre only** = the race playlists for that style. **Cities only** = the general blocks of each map.
rm.confirm: I understand this **deletes files** from the workspace (an automatic backup is made)
rm.done_rebuilt: {n} removed — audio: {audio} · playlists: {pl} · strings: {str} · DATs rebuilt · backup: {backup}
rm.empty: — no songs (workspace empty or not prepared) —
rm.intro: Removes installed tracks: deletes the **.rsm** and takes it out of the **playlists** and **strings** (each action is optional). Makes an **automatic backup** first.
rm.log_placeholder: — the removal log shows up here —
rm.placeholder: — click Refresh (the workspace must be prepared) —
rm.prepare_first: prepare the project first (Prepare project tab)
rb.intro: Repacks the edited game folders into **STREAMS.DAT** (hash_build) and **ASSETS.DAT** (dave) and **publishes** them to the **"Arquivos da ISO"** folder. Runs the real PS2 tools.
rb.log_placeholder: — the rebuild log shows up here —
rb.ready: tools and workspace ready to rebuild
bk.confirm: I understand that restoring **overwrites and deletes** workspace files
bk.intro: Saves a copy of the key files (DATs, playlists, strings) and lets you **undo** by restoring the latest backup. It's the safety net before any destructive change.
bk.log_placeholder: — the backup log shows up here —
bk.undo_hint: to undo: Rebuild & Backup → tick the confirmation → “Restore latest backup”. Backup for this operation: {backup}
iso.intro: Rebuilds the DATs and assembles the final playable **.iso** (with **ImgBurn**) from the **"Arquivos da ISO"** folder. Writes a new file — your editing folders are not changed.
iso.log_placeholder: — the build log shows up here —
iso.missing_ps2: PS2 tools (dave/hash_build) — building the ISO rebuilds the DATs first
iso.ready: ImgBurn and the "Arquivos da ISO" folder are ready
settings.install_log_placeholder: — the tool installation log shows up here —
settings.intro: Language, PC tools and workflow defaults. Your choices are **saved** and come back the next time you open the app.
settings.support_intro: Something went wrong? This copies a **complete** report (app diagnostics + the last error) and opens the project's issue page — you review it and post it. **Nothing is sent unless you send it.**
inst.no_winget: winget not found — use “Open page” to download {tool} manually.
report.not_opened: The page didn't open. Go to {url} and paste the report below.
report.opened: Page opened at {url} — paste the report below into the description.
report.select_copy: Selected below — copy it with Ctrl+C and paste it at {url}.
err.batch_duplicates: Adding cancelled: {n} internal name(s) repeated in the batch — the tracks would overwrite each other. Edit the title/artist (or the internal name) to tell them apart. {detail}
err.dat_not_in_gamefiles: {dat} not found in the "Arquivos da ISO" folder: {path}
err.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg not found in tools/wav to rsm or on the Windows PATH.
err.fill_fields: Fill in the title, artist, genre and internal file name.
err.imgburn_failed: ImgBurn could not build the final ISO.{detail}
err.imgburn_missing: ImgBurn was not found. Install ImgBurn to build the final ISO.
err.iso_mount_failed: Could not mount the selected ISO.
err.iso_no_boot2: Could not identify the ISO's BOOT2.
err.iso_no_dats: The ISO does not contain ASSETS.DAT and STREAMS.DAT in the expected layout.
err.iso_no_drive: The ISO was mounted, but its drive letter could not be found.
err.iso_no_system_cnf: SYSTEM.CNF was not found in the ISO.
err.iso_unsupported: This ISO is not the version this app can edit. Detected BOOT2={boot}; the supported one is {game}. Other versions/regions of the game store their internal files in a different format, and the extraction would fail halfway.
err.no_action: Tick at least one action (audio, playlists or strings).
err.no_compatible_playlist: {name}: no playlist compatible with the {genre} genre
err.no_space: Not enough space to {what}: about {needed} is needed and {free} is free on {where}. Free up space or install the app on a drive with more room (the workspace lives in the program folder).
err.no_system_cnf_gamefiles: SYSTEM.CNF was not found in the "Arquivos da ISO" folder.
err.no_valid_batch: No valid tracks in the batch. {detail}
err.no_valid_songs: No valid songs were prepared for adding.
err.pick_playlist: Select at least one target playlist.
err.rsm_empty: rstm_build finished without producing the RSM file.
err.rstm_missing: rstm_build not found in tools/wav to rsm.
err.strings_json_missing: mcstrings02.json was not found for compiling.
err.strtbl_decode_extracted: Failed to decode mcstrings02.strtbl (the game's text table). The extracted file is {size} bytes. This usually means the ISO is not the supported version ({game}) or the extraction ended up incomplete (full disk or antivirus). Use the error report button to send the diagnostics.{detail}
err.strtbl_encode: Failed to compile mcstrings02.json into mcstrings02.strtbl.{detail}
err.strtbl_not_in_assets: mcstrings02.strtbl was not found inside ASSETS/fonts.
err.targets_exist: Adding cancelled: {n} target .rsm file(s) already exist. Tick the overwrite option to continue.
err.timeout: The tool took too long and was stopped.
err.tool_py_frozen: The {tool} tool only exists as a .py file, and this app is packaged (no Python interpreter). Reinstall the app — it should ship the .exe tools in tools/.
log.build_output_warning: WARNING: this workspace is inside a build folder ({dirs}). Rebuilding the app DELETES that whole folder, including the extraction and the backups. For real use, install the app in its own folder.
log.iso_copied: ISO copied ({n} file(s)). Decompiling the workspace...
log.no_winget: winget was not found on this Windows.
log.published: Published to the "Arquivos da ISO" folder: {path}
log.removed_new: Removed (did not exist before the backup): {path}
log.reset_done: Reset complete: {n} item(s) removed. Backups kept.
log.tags_failed: Warning: could not read the tags of {name}: {error}
progress.imgburn: Building the final ISO with ImgBurn...
progress.rebuild_before_iso: Rebuilding the DATs before building the ISO...
progress.reset_done: Project reset. Choose a new ISO to start.
progress.writing_strings: Writing mcstrings02.json and rebuilding the STRTBL...
